task: Public-key toolkit ae.pk: ECC (P-256, secp256k1), RFC 6979 ECDSA, strict DER, ECDH, Miller-Rabin, RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256
reasoning_summary: Jacobian-coordinate curve arithmetic checked against a naive affine oracle, RFC 6979 vectors and JDK signature/key-agreement; RSA signatures byte-equal to JDK's deterministic PKCS#1 v1.5. A tiny brute-forced curve exercises nonce-retry and encoding-boundary paths. A 45-mutant pass left 12 survivors; 8 were test gaps (closed), 4 are equivalent.
